niche_preference_profile: This user most often prefers interfaces that feel clean, structured, and readable, with strong hierarchy, clear section separation, and moderate-to-generous spacing. They frequently favor light neutral surfaces with dark text and soft purple accents, but they also respond positively to dark themes when those dark UIs use clear contrast, dimmed/gradient backgrounds, and well-defined modular cards. Across both light and dark styles, they consistently like simplified compositions, cohesive controls, rounded cards/buttons, and layouts that avoid clutter while still presenting enough visible structure and useful content.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers prominent titles, readable supporting text, visible subtitles/section labels, and obvious prioritization of primary content and actions.
Prefers layouts with breathing room, open spacing, and fewer competing elements, while still maintaining clear grouping and organization.
Prefers interfaces with legible text, clearer contrast, and stronger separation between surfaces, cards, and content areas.
Prefers modular cards, stacked sections, overlays, or dividers that distinctly separate content instead of continuous or blended layouts.
Prefers cleaner compositions with fewer decorative effects, fewer floating elements, simpler controls, and less ornamental styling.
Prefers softer purple/lavender accents and consistent accent application over brighter blue, teal, pink-red, or mixed accent treatments.
Prefers softer rounded corners, pill-like buttons, and generally gentler edge treatment over sharper or flatter components.
